title: SaveEditorSettingsRequest
description: Parameters of editor.save. Carries only the two things the user authored; whether VS Code and Visual Studio are installed is the host's to discover and never the renderer's to claim.

customDiffCommand.description: Command template for comparing two files, with {left} and {right} standing for them. Empty clears it.

customOpenCommand.description: Command template for opening one file, with {file} and {line} standing for it. Empty clears it.
